classification: Configurable mobilisation capacity; reference value is not a physiological maximum
notes: Effective mobilisation cap equals release_cap_mmol_min times liver_function_fraction.
Requested release, remaining glycogen and hepatic flow/export capacity can further limit actual release.
Changing mobilisation capacity does not add glycogen or change organ demand, coronary conductance or local buffering.
The default reproduces the historical capacity setting; higher settings are exploratory assumptions.
